### What to Look for in Custody & Mediation Matters

1. **Accredited Family Dispute Resolution Practitioner (FDRP):** If you need compulsory mediation before filing for parenting orders in the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia, ensure your practitioner can issue a section 60I certificate if an agreement cannot be reached.
2. **QLD Law Society Accredited Specialists:** Look for lawyers who have formal specialist accreditation in family law, indicating a rigorous peer-reviewed mastery of complex custody and property legislation.
3. **Cost Disclosure:** Ensure the firm provides a clear, comprehensive **Costs Agreement** outlining billing structures and tailored estimates from the very first consultation.[[1]](https://www.australianfamilylawyers.com.au/cm-family-lawyers-mount-gravatt)
